summary: Preserve the temporal dead zone of a class declaration when code may access the class binding before class evaluation completes.

target.notes: Represent the class binding with a lexical slot that throws ReferenceError until initialized at the class evaluation point.

semantics.class_body_self_reference_before_initial: ReferenceError during computed-key/static initialization when applicable

caveats: A plain C# type name is available independent of source textual order, so it cannot model this TDZ by itself.

tests.name: predeclaration access throws
tests.expected_csharp: var C = JsLexicalBinding.Uninitialized("C"); /* use */ JsLexicalBinding.Get(C); /* class eval */
tests.expected_behavior: throws ReferenceError before class declaration initializes

tests.name: edge: ordinary post-declaration use succeeds
tests.expected_behavior: does not throw for TDZ; later class-value semantics are handled separately
